sample_unit: questions (each submitted in English and Chinese to two LLMs)

links.outcome: English readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of LLM patient education responses
links.effect: DeepSeek scored 39.4±5.5 versus ChatGPT 35.1±8.4 (P=0.031); both are low Flesch scores, indicating difficult text; Chinese readability comparable.
links.quote: For English readability, DeepSeek scored significantly higher (39.4±5.5 versus 35.1±8.4, P =0.031), while Chinese readability was comparable.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM clinical answers on craniofacial microsomia questions
links.effect: DeepSeek more accurate than ChatGPT in English (score 1: 86.4% vs 45.5%, P=0.004) and Chinese (77.3% vs 40.9%, P=0.014), but only DeepSeek produced inaccurate or misleading content (score 3).
links.quote: DeepSeek demonstrated significantly higher accuracy than ChatGPT in both English (score 1: 86.4% versus 45.5%, P =0.004) and Chinese (77.3% versus 40.9%, P =0.014).

screen.reason: Evaluates baseline performance, readability, and safety statement frequency of ChatGPT and DeepSeek on answering questions about craniofacial microsomia without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
